definitions.gloss: swimming goggles; underwater goggles; diving mask
definitions.explanation: Covers both competitive swim goggles and snorkeling/diving masks.

examples.japanese: {水中|すいちゅう}めがね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
{子供用|こどもよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水中|すいちゅう}めがね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I bought children's swim goggles for them.

examples.japanese: {水中|すいちゅう}めがね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When I put on the goggles, I could clearly see the fish in the ocean.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{水中|すいちゅう}→水中：13310_suichuu⟧ (underwater) and めがね (glasses/goggles). This is the general Japanese term for any eyewear used underwater, from children's pool goggles to snorkeling masks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水中|すいちゅう}めがね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to put on goggles
- {水中|すいちゅう}めがね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off goggles
- {水中|すいちゅう}めがね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曇|くも}る→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧: goggles fogging up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゴーグル→ゴーグル：07086_googuru⟧: goggles (loanword, used especially for competitive swimming)
- ⟦{水中|すいちゅう}→水中：13310_suichuu⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧: underwater mask (more for diving/snorkeling)
- {水中眼鏡|すいちゅうがんきょう}: same word using kanji for めがね (less common in everyday use)

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, ⟦ゴーグル→ゴーグル：07086_googuru⟧ is increasingly used for competitive swimming goggles, while {水中|すいちゅう}めがね remains the general term, especially in casual family contexts like pool or beach outings.
